Package com.example.model

Class MediaEntry

java.lang.Object
com.example.model.MediaEntry
Direct Known Subclasses:
Album, Book, Series
public abstract class MediaEntry extends Object
The class MediaEntry serves as the abstract class for the classes Book, Album, and Series
It contains a constructor to define and initialize an entry's information as attributes, and accompanying methods and getters for adding, manipulating, and returning such attributes
